mcpServers._comment_security: Security catalog entries below are OPTIONAL and OFF until owner enables. Use env ${VAR} only — never hardcode secrets. Toggle each in Cursor Settings > MCP after restart + Authorize.

semgrep._note: DEFAULT OFF — enable in Cursor Settings > MCP. Defensive SAST only. No token committed.

snyk._note: DEFAULT OFF — enable in Cursor Settings > MCP. SCA/SAST. Token via env only.

sonarqube._note: DEFAULT OFF — enable in Cursor Settings > MCP. Code quality/security. Token+URL via env only.

trivy._note: DEFAULT OFF — enable in Cursor Settings > MCP. Vuln/SBOM/IaC scanning. No secret required for local scans.

jfrog._note: DEFAULT OFF — enable in Cursor Settings > MCP. Artifact/SBOM/Xray. Token+URL via env only.

endor-labs._note: DEFAULT OFF — enable in Cursor Settings > MCP. SCA/reachability/SBOM. Credentials via env only.

_security_disabled_examples.notes: Copy a block into mcpServers and replace ${VAR} after Cursor restart + Authorize.
